title: Treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow/glow beneath chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#2a1a0a' />

  <!-- chest body -->
  <rect x='18' y='52' width='64' height='32' rx='3' fill='#8B5A2B' />
  <!-- body planks -->
  <rect x='18' y='58' width='64' height='2' fill='#A0713E' />
  <rect x='18' y='66' width='64' height='2' fill='#A0713E' />
  <rect x='18' y='74' width='64' height='2' fill='#A0713E' />
  <!-- body edge highlights -->
  <rect x='18' y='52' width='64' height='3' fill='#C08A4E' />
  <rect x='18' y='81' width='64' height='3' fill='#6B421D' />

  <!-- lid -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q18 34 50 34 Q82 34 82 52 Z' fill='#A0713E' />
  <!-- lid highlight top -->
  <path d='M22 52 Q22 38 50 38 Q78 38 78 52 Z' fill='#C08A4E' />
  <!-- lid dark bottom strip -->
  <path d='M18 50 Q18 52 50 52 Q82 52 82 50 L82 52 Q82 56 50 56 Q18 56 18 52 Z' fill='#6B421D' />

  <!-- metal bands -->
  <rect x='26' y='38' width='7' height='46' fill='#D4A030' />
  <rect x='26' y='38' width='3' height='46' fill='#F0C860' />
  <rect x='67' y='38' width='7' height='46' fill='#D4A030' />
  <rect x='67' y='38' width='3' height='46' fill='#F0C860' />
  <!-- lid band curve -->
  <path d='M26 38 Q26 34 30 34 L33 34 Q29 38 29 52 L26 52 Z' fill='#D4A030' />
  <path d='M67 38 Q67 34 71 34 L74 34 Q74 38 74 52 L71 52 Z' fill='#D4A030' />

  <!-- lock plate -->
  <rect x='43' y='48' width='14' height='16' rx='2' fill='#D4A030' />
  <rect x='45' y='50' width='10' height='12' rx='1' fill='#F0C860' />
  <!-- keyhole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='2.2' fill='#6B421D' />
  <rect x='48.8' y='56' width='2.4' height='4' fill='#6B421D' />

  <!-- coins peeking out -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='49' r='4' fill='#FFD700' />
  <circle cx='36' cy='49' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#FFE870' stroke-width='1' />
  <circle cx='42' cy='47' r='4.5' fill='#FFD700' />
  <circle cx='48' cy='48' r='4' fill='#FFC800' />
  <circle cx='55' cy='47' r='4.5' fill='#FFD700' />
  <circle cx='61' cy='49' r='4' fill='#FFC800' />
  <circle cx='65' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#FFD700' />

  <!-- coin glints -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='45.5' r='1' fill='#FFF5B0' />
  <circle cx='53' cy='45' r='1' fill='#FFF5B0' />
  <circle cx='63' cy='46' r='0.8' fill='#FFF5B0' />

  <!-- sparkle gems -->
  <polygon points='50,36 52,40 56,41 52,42 50,46 48,42 44,41 48,40' fill='#7FFFD4' />
  <polygon points='30,42 31.5,44.5 34,45 31.5,45.5 30,48 28.5,45.5 26,45 28.5,44.5' fill='#FF7FD4' />
  <polygon points='70,43 71.5,45.5 74,46 71.5,46.5 70,49 68.5,46.5 66,46 68.5,45.5' fill='#7FFFD4' />
</svg>
